aboutGame.title: What is SpongeBob Tower Defense?
paragraphs: SpongeBob Tower Defense is a Roblox wave-defense game where you collect Bikini Bottom characters as units, drop them onto build spots along a fixed enemy path, and spend in-match cash to upgrade them before the waves reach your base. Every match feeds a longer collection loop: you summon new units between runs, then draw on that roster to build a stronger team for the next stage.

The game blends tower defense strategy with character collection. Story chapters hand you tuned waves and scripted boss fights, while Endless Mode keeps scaling enemies and rewards teams that cover damage, crowd control, economy, and support instead of stacking one role. Gems gate the biggest account upgrades, so farming and summoning decisions matter as much as placement inside any single run.

items.question: What is SpongeBob Tower Defense?
items.answer: SpongeBob Tower Defense is a Roblox wave-defense game where you collect Bikini Bottom characters as units, place them on build spots along a fixed enemy path, and upgrade them with in-match cash to stop every wave from reaching your base. Between runs you summon new units to build a stronger roster.

items.question: How do I redeem SpongeBob Tower Defense codes?
items.answer: Reach Level 10, open the Codes button on the left side of the screen, and paste a code into the Enter Code Here box. SpongeBob Tower Defense codes are case-sensitive, so copy them exactly as published.

items.question: Which units should beginners use in SpongeBob Tower Defense?
items.answer: Start with one reliable main damage unit and upgrade it before spreading cash across the whole board. Add economy and crowd-control units once your core damage is stable, then fill the remaining build spots with support.

items.question: What is the best way to farm Gems in SpongeBob Tower Defense?
items.answer: Stack repeatable sources instead of chasing one stage. Clear story chapters for first-time rewards, run efficient modes for steady income, and redeem SpongeBob Tower Defense codes for free Gems and crates.

items.question: Is there an Endless Mode in SpongeBob Tower Defense?
items.answer: Yes. Endless Mode keeps spawning waves with continuously scaling enemy stats, so it rewards teams that cover damage, crowd control, economy, and support rather than stacking a single role.
